notes: Do not commit API keys. Set FINVL_SELECTOR_API_KEY in the shell before running.
Set PADDLEOCR_VL_API_URL and PADDLEOCR_VL_API_TOKEN to use the remote layout-parsing API.
When the remote PaddleOCR-VL API is enabled, the hybrid adapter defaults to PaddleOCR-VL markdown only and skips local OCR evidence.
ernie-5.0-thinking-preview is supported, but local testing showed very high latency for batch evaluation.
